sources.entry: Chief Technology Officer vs Coder Thinker Organizer *(GitHub)*

summary.one_liner: A curated list of articles and blog posts about the role of the Chief Technology Officer, covering what CTOs do, how to hire one, and traits of effective ones.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is a link list rather than code. It contains a single "Articles & Posts" section with 25 numbered entries, each a titled article about the CTO role, mostly aimed at startups and tech companies. Topics include defining the CTO job versus VP Engineering, traits and qualities of successful CTOs, balancing technology and people, and hiring a CTO. The list has no descriptions, authors, or links in the README text provided, only titles. A "Licence" section says "Uncopyrighted" with no named license.
use_cases: Reading about what a startup CTO actually does
Researching how to hire a CTO
Defining CTO versus VP Engineering roles
Finding traits of successful technology executives
Learning how to balance technology and people management
notable: Curated list of 25 CTO-focused articles in one place
Covers startup CTO hiring, role definition, and leadership traits
Includes posts that survey or interview many CTOs, such as a study of Berlin CTOs
caveats: Only article titles are given; no links, summaries, or dates appear in the README text provided
No software to install or run
License is stated only as 'Uncopyrighted', which is not a formal open-source license
